text: Soren Lindqvist takes Meridian's 4-of-12 asset problem and starts turning it into math a quantum computer can actually run.
Twelve binary variables, one per asset -- expected return rewarded, risk penalized, and 'pick exactly four' folded in as a penalty term instead of a side rule.
That QUBO gets mechanically converted into an Ising Hamiltonian -- the Pauli-operator form QAOA's circuit is actually built around.
Felix Nakamura's brute-force answer from lesson eight is the ground truth this whole pipeline will eventually be checked against.
Next: building the actual depth-2 QAOA circuit around this Hamiltonian.
